prompt: Who was the Argentinian president who resigned from the position the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated?
answer: Pedro Pablo Ramírez was the Argentine president who resigned in 1944, the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated.
